nodes.value: Select formal-method targets by consequence and ambiguity rather than prestige.
Bind each formal model to named implementation contracts and assumptions.
Treat counterexamples as engineering inputs and proofs as scoped evidence, never universal correctness.
Version benchmark datasets, prompts, scoring, models and environments.
Require credible baselines and statistical uncertainty for comparative claims.
Track contamination, memorization risk, cost, latency and hardware alongside quality.
Map campaigns to explicit threat models and system owners.
Contain harmful side effects with sandbox, synthetic targets and kill switches.
Convert confirmed findings into tracked risks, fixes and permanent regression evidence.
Provide pause, cancel, deny, approve, revoke and break-glass controls at explicit control points.
Make authority changes durable, attributable and immediately visible to active work.
Require autonomous delegation to remain a subset of human-granted authority.
Explain decisions using observable inputs, rules, evidence, tool receipts and model outputs.
Separate causal/provenance facts from post-hoc summaries and uncertainty.
Redact secrets, private data and hidden operational internals from explanation surfaces.
Provide keyboard/screen-reader reachable controls and semantic status for critical workflows.
Support scalable text, contrast, motion reduction and non-color-only signaling.
Include accessibility in release acceptance rather than treating it as cosmetic polish.
Keep persisted numbers, timestamps, enums and identifiers locale-neutral.
Localize presentation, formatting and messages through versioned resources.
Require fallback behavior and review for untranslated safety/authority-critical text.
Represent jurisdiction, applicability, owner and review date for compliance requirements.
Map applicable obligations to concrete data, security, retention, access and evidence controls.
Keep legal interpretation reviewable and separate from automatic technical enforcement where ambiguity exists.
Identify machine-derived versus human-authored documentation sections explicitly.
Validate links, referenced identifiers and version relationships automatically.
Preserve human rationale and operational warnings during regeneration.
Bind every generated artifact to source digests and generator version.
Require deterministic ordering and stable formatting for reviewability.
Mark generated outputs clearly and regenerate rather than hand-editing derived sections.
Write runbooks against named signals, commands, authority and rollback points.
Test high-risk runbooks in drills and update them from incident evidence.
Document degraded modes and explicit stop/escalation conditions.
Classify maintenance actions by risk and require bounded automated mutation.
Preserve active migration, generated, release and evidence artifacts through explicit ownership rules.
Track stale branches/files/dependencies with evidence before deletion.
Give backlog items stable IDs, source rationale, owner, dependency and closure rule.
Deduplicate overlapping work while preserving provenance from issues/gaps/risks.
Automatically retire or revalidate tasks when upstream conditions change.
Separate hard blockers from soft ranking signals.
Use transparent priority factors with provenance and bounded weights.
Recompute priority when dependencies, risks, evidence or resource constraints change.
Require objective, non-goals, dependencies, interfaces, state owners, risks, tests and rollback in each package.
Map every package to atomic AIQ tasks and volume requirements.
Derive package completion from underlying signed evidence rather than manual status.
Exercise clean bootstrap through durable state creation, eventing and controlled shutdown.
Restart from persisted state and rebuild derived projections deterministically.
Inject interruption/corruption cases and verify recovery or explicit fail-closed outcomes.
Start from durable conversation and explicit user objective.
Compile governed context, invoke provider-neutral inference, authorize any tool side effect and verify result.
Commit terminal state and stream/replay the authoritative outcome across reconnect.
Use repository graph and explicit task objective to produce a bounded change plan.
Acquire mutation lease/fencing before edits and preserve provenance for every change.
Require independent tests/review/verification and reversible commit/rollback path.
Capture source identity, method, claim scope and limitations before synthesis.
Build evidence/claim relationships and reproduce key results where feasible.
Run bounded experiments with preregistered metrics and preserve negative/ambiguous outcomes.
Assign explicit roles, scopes, leases and handoff packets to each agent.
Detect overlapping mutation/conflict domains before commit.
Require bounded coordination, verifier independence and recoverable partial failure.
Generate candidates only in isolated experiment scope.
Compare challenger against champion on predeclared quality, safety, cost and robustness evidence.
Require independent promotion decision, canary and executable rollback.
Distribute only work with explicit identity, lease/fencing and idempotency semantics.
Exercise worker loss, partition, delayed messages and recovery.
Reconcile authoritative outcomes before reissuing uncertain external effects.
Install from signed release artifact on clean supported environment.
Complete VS-001-level AI operation and produce a governed artifact.
Restart, update, migrate, verify and rollback while preserving authoritative state.
Require successful VS-001 plus mapped failure, recovery, security and quality evidence.
Verify authoritative state, tool governance, provenance and terminal streaming semantics.
Record independent acceptance against exact source/config/model/environment identity.
Require bounded objectives, budgets, checkpoints, human override and durable recovery.
Demonstrate delegated authority subsets, tool governance and long-horizon stability.
Exercise interruption, stale work, conflict, deadline and resource-exhaustion conditions.
Require source provenance, claim/evidence scope, contradiction handling and reproducibility records.
Validate experiment methodology, uncertainty and negative-result preservation.
Use independent review for high-impact research conclusions.
Require credible baselines, reproducibility, contamination analysis and statistical support.
Characterize robustness, security, latency, cost and operational constraints.
Require independent verification and scope the claim to exact benchmark/task/population.
Tie each anti-pattern to concrete failure history, detection and preferred alternative.
Automate detection where the pattern is syntactically or structurally observable.
Require explicit exception owner, rationale and expiry when unavoidable.
Represent hard dependencies, soft overlap and stop conditions explicitly.
Prevent downstream maturity claims before required upstream contracts/evidence exist.
Recompute order when gaps, risks or dependency topology changes.
Define required artifacts/evidence by maturity and change impact.
Require tests, failure/recovery behavior, observability, rollback and ownership where applicable.
Derive completion from immutable evidence plus required independent signoff.
Require objectives, non-goals, dependencies, interfaces, authority, state, failure, tests, rollback and evidence sections.
Link machine identifiers rather than retyping mutable status where possible.
Keep packets diffable, resumable and suitable for independent review.
Give every traceable node stable identity and typed edges.
Reject dangling or contradictory traceability references.
Support impact analysis from either requirement or changed implementation.
Give capabilities stable IDs, owners, maturity and dependency metadata.
Separate implemented availability from target-plan intent.
Expose degraded/unavailable states without silently rerouting into weaker guarantees.
Record candidate purpose, baseline, risks, owner, budget and decision horizon.
Keep experiments sandboxed until promotion evidence exists.
Define retirement/replacement triggers for adopted technologies.
Record debt source, affected contracts, risk, owner and target disposition.
Prevent debt cleanup from bypassing migration, compatibility and rollback requirements.
Turn high-value architecture rules into deterministic executable checks.
Version rules with architecture decisions and focused regression fixtures.
Make exemptions explicit, narrow, owned and expiring.
Separate activity, throughput, quality, risk and outcome metrics.
Derive metrics from authoritative artifacts/events where possible.
Treat metrics as diagnostic signals; completion remains evidence-gated.
Link roadmap items to work packages, risks, dependencies and acceptance gates.
Replan explicitly when assumptions change while preserving decision history.
Enforce breadth freeze and route new top-level scope through architecture decision process.
Use signed atomic task/accountability records as the completion source.
Define deterministic aggregation for packages, waves, slices and volumes.
Expose blocked/partial states and critical exceptions instead of averaging them away.
Run applicable vertical slices in release-like environment from signed artifacts.
Exercise cross-component failure, restore, upgrade, rollback and authority controls.
Produce one digest-bound final evidence bundle with independent verification and explicit unresolved-risk disposition.
